lead.headline: Taylor on the block, Jacobs under review — and 11.6 left on the bench
lead.deck: Won 149.48 to 95.88 in Week 8. Week 9: three coin flips set the wrong way, Tuten DNP Monday on a Thursday game, no claim worth priority.
lead.body: The bad news is two starters with outside problems. The Colts are shopping Jonathan Taylor — a deal is 'more likely than not' before 10 Nov (Schultz via RotoWire 1 Nov) — and the NFL will review three new allegations against Josh Jacobs (PFT 31 Oct); neither has a date. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Monday and plays Thursday night. Week 8 was a 149.48 to 95.88 win with 11.6 on the bench — Rice's 18.3 behind Taylor's 6.7, the projection's call. For Week 9, start Gordon over Tuten before Thursday, then Rice over Wilson and Likely over Loveland: three coin flips, the projection's side. Nothing on the wire is worth priority.
